pages.lesson:
LESSON: SELECTED HADITH UNITY AVOIDANCE OF ILL MOTIVES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Ulum al-Hadith • Books of Hadith • Classification of Hadith • Collect
Topic 2.2: Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is the unity of Muslims important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim
2. practise the teachings from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in daily life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. practise the teachings from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in daily life
   In simple words: practise until you can practise the teachings from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in daily life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives in the examples.
2. Explain Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
4. Show that you can: explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Role-play situations where Muslims can display unity in the community,
2. Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners discuss the lessons derived from the selected Hadith in groups.
3. Creativity and Imagination: the skill of making connections is enhanced when learners explain the relevance of the selected Hadith in the life of a Muslim and make notes.
4. Communication and Collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners dramatise the effects of ill motives. Values:
5. Unity is enhanced when learners discuss the lessons derived from the Hadith on unity in groups.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the unity of Muslims important?
2. Why should Muslims avoid ill motives?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim
2. practise the teachings from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
